title: Kabouter Plop and the birthday.
lines: Deep in the forest, where the trees are tall and the mushrooms are big, there's a little village.
They have red pointy hats and long beards.
Their houses are made of wood and they have little windows.
The boss of the village is Kabouter Plop.
He has a white beard and a red hat.
Klus the gnome can make anything with his hammer and his saw.
Lui the gnome would rather sleep all day in his hammock.
And Smul the gnome loves to eat.
There's also Kwebbel, the girl gnome, who talks a lot.
And who always knows everything first.
One morning Plop is walking through the forest.
Do you know what I heard?
And he thinks everyone has forgotten!
Then we must throw a party!
But shhh, Lui mustn't find out!
Klus, can you make a present for Lui?
I'll make a new, super soft hammock.
Smul, can you bake a cake?
And he's already running to his kitchen.
Red and white, like the hats.
And she writes on a big board: Happy birthday, Lui!
But how will they keep it a secret?
Klus makes a lot of noise with his hammer.
He's fixing a, er, a mushroom.
Yes, a broken mushroom, says Plop.
Lui shrugs and goes back to sleep.
I'm baking a cake for, er, for the squirrels!
But he's too tired to ask any more.
Then Kwebbel comes by with the streamers.
She's holding them behind her back.
Lui, do you know what tomorrow is?
shout Plop, Klus and Smul at the same time.
Kwebbel claps her hand over her mouth.
The next morning Lui wakes up.
It's very quiet in the village.
There are red and white streamers.
There's an enormous cake with strawberries and whipped cream.
And in the middle of the room hangs a new hammock, super soft, with a little pillow.
That's why Klus was making so much noise.
And that's why you could smell cake.
They sing a song for Lui.
Then Lui lies down in his new hammock.
And do you know what he does?
Plop laughs and pulls a blanket over him.
